name: fashion-theme-team
description: The SkyyRose motherbase and governed Fashion Theme Brain for prompt-orchestrated, evidence-backed, end-to-end WooCommerce fashion theme delivery.

interface.longDescription: Runs the branded SkyyRose Fashion Theme Brain from discovery and full V2 page-and-imagery planning through complete WooCommerce implementation, browser QA, accessibility, performance, packaging, and candidate-bound release evidence.
defaultPrompt: Take this fashion theme from audit through release evidence.
Build a design system and production-ready WooCommerce funnel.
Audit this fashion storefront and dispatch the right specialists.
Build a complete page-by-page fashion storefront contract with rendered HTML and schema-valid JSON handoffs.
Plan every V2 storefront page, section, feature, responsive transformation, and imagery brief.
Build a native cinematic collection scene from exact SKU sources and hold it behind product, optical-integration, story, and founder gates.
Use prompt engineering, typed prompt chains, and safe prompt caching to deliver a complete candidate in one pass.
Implement the 44-item premium feature catalog to enterprise production standard with evidence.
Route a bundled branded skill through its SkyyRose gap-closure contract and authenticated sources.
Run this Fashion Theme Team capability as a strict end-to-end task with named ownership, first-seen issues, independent evidence, and founder approval.
Synchronize the Fashion Theme Team's DevSkyy vendor package and installed cache from one verified source.
